name: Blueprint {OS}
tagline: The product-definition compiler: a complete, traceable definition pack.

commands.name: /blueprint <idea>
commands.does: Start a NEW compile from an idea plus project context

commands.name: /blueprint-os
commands.does: Open the compiler and detect the right mode

commands.name: recover
commands.does: Rebuild canonical truth from prior sources

commands.name: extend <module>
commands.does: Add scope, preserve IDs, report the impact set

commands.name: revise <id>
commands.does: Supersede a record and propagate to its dependents

commands.name: audit
commands.does: Report gaps, orphans, conflicts and the G01 to G20 verdicts

commands.name: delta <a> <b>
commands.does: Semantic diff between two frozen versions with blast radius

commands.name: continue
commands.does: Resume exactly at the stored continuation pointer

commands.name: omega-blueprint validate
commands.does: Validate structure and semantic invariants, exit 1 on critical or high

commands.name: omega-blueprint status
commands.does: Concise status card: revision, coverage, gates, unknowns

commands.name: omega-blueprint checkpoint
commands.does: Advance the revision and store the continuation pointer

commands.name: omega-blueprint demo
commands.does: Print a valid minimal state to read

requires_human_approval_for: freezing a handoff version, since downstream planning becomes bound to it
recording a legal, financial, data-ownership or irreversible architecture choice as decided
declaring BLUEPRINT COMPLETE, STEPPER READY while a critical gate is amber
accepting a downstream change request that alters product scope
